preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Input consists of lines of text only.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) >= 1 and all(line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Input is non-empty and contains no empty lines.
First line is a positive integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10^5) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 3*i].split()[0]) <= 10**3 and 1 <= int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 3*i].split()[1]) <= int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 3*i].split()[0]) for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0])))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line contains two integers N and K (2 ≤ N ≤ 10^3, 1 ≤ K ≤ N).

preconditions.expression: all(len(stdin.splitlines()[2 + 3*i]) == int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 3*i].split()[0]) and all(c in '01' for c in stdin.splitlines()[2 + 3*i]) for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0])))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line is a binary string S of length N (each character is '0' or '1').

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.splitlines()) == int(stdin.splitlines()[0]) for stdout in [stdout] if stdout)
postconditions.description: Output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line in map(str, range(-1, N + 1)) for N, line in zip([int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 3*i].split()[0]) for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: Each output line is either -1 or an integer between 1 and N (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: all((result == -1) or (1 <= result <= N) for N, result in zip([int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 3*i].split()[0]) for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))], map(int, stdout.splitlines())))
postconditions.description: If output is not -1, it is a valid block index (1 ≤ result ≤ N).

postconditions.expression: all((result == -1) or (exists(sequence := [1] + [j for j in range(2, N + 1) if (i < j and S[i-1] != S[j-1]) for i in sequence[:-1]], len(sequence) == K + 1, sequence[-1] == result) for S, N, K, result in zip([stdin.splitlines()[2 + 3*i] for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))], [int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 3*i].split()[0]) for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))], [int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 3*i].split()[1]) for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))], map(int, stdout.splitlines()))))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if the output is not -1, there exists a sequence of K jumps starting at block 1, alternating colors at each jump, ending at the output block, and no longer sequence of K jumps exists.

postconditions.expression: all((result == -1) or (not exists(sequence := [1] + [j for j in range(2, N + 1) if (i < j and S[i-1] != S[j-1]) for i in sequence[:-1]], len(sequence) == K + 1, sequence[-1] > result)) for S, N, K, result in zip([stdin.splitlines()[2 + 3*i] for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))], [int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 3*i].split()[0]) for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))], [int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 3*i].split()[1]) for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))], map(int, stdout.splitlines())))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if the output is not -1, it is the farthest block reachable with exactly K jumps.

postconditions.expression: all((result == -1) or (not exists(sequence := [1] + [j for j in range(2, N + 1) if (i < j and S[i-1] != S[j-1]) for i in sequence[:-1]], len(sequence) == K + 1)) for S, N, K, result in zip([stdin.splitlines()[2 + 3*i] for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))], [int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 3*i].split()[0]) for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))], [int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 3*i].split()[1]) for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))], map(int, stdout.splitlines())))
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, it means exactly K jumps are possible.
